title: [Wave 0] [Layer: DevOps] Initialize monorepo folder structure
body:
## Goal
Establish clear backend/frontend/infra paths for the team.

## Step-by-step checklist
- [ ] Create `backend/`, `frontend/`, `infra/`, `docs/` at repo root
- [ ] Add root `README.md` with stack overview and local dev pointers
- [ ] Add `.gitignore` for Python, Node, `.env`, `.netlify`
- [ ] Document branch naming in `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`

## Acceptance criteria (DoD)
All folders exist; README links to each package; git status clean.

## Estimated effort
1h

## Difficulty
Easy
